reviewed_changes: One continuous full-size artist gradient replaces five adjacent bands, removing internal edges susceptible to fractional Windows DPI/zoom gaps and overlaps
The continuous fade has a matching page-colour end fill to avoid gradient colour-rounding seams; image extent, identity layout, Popular spacing and discography positions remain unchanged
Whole-row hover reveals the fixed index play control; the existing hover reference now activates from the row centre rather than the index

Wheel smoothing uses frame-time decay without restarting on each tick, guarantees first-frame response, tolerates small pointer jitter and cancels pending opposite-direction movement; interaction-state tests cover sustained input and settling
All 160 native references repeat exactly on macOS 15; settings references show 0.8.15
Final Windows path uses a borderless gradient and an opaque end fill to avoid enabling outer-edge antialiasing; the captured source and environment remain recorded above
